instruction: Use Bonsai's native IFC authoring workflow to create a new metric IFC4 studio-flat model. Start from a blank project; no init_file inputs or reference images are provided. Save the completed model as result.ifc in the output folder. The model should contain one project, one site, one building, one building storey named Studio Level, three spaces, six walls, one slab, one door, three windows, four opening elements, four void relationships, and four fill relationships. Do not include building element proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep all IfcRoot GlobalId values unique. Name the spaces Living, Bath, and Kitchenette. Their world-coordinate plan spans should be Living 4.40 m by 4.60 m, Bath 1.80 m by 1.80 m, and Kitchenette 1.80 m by 2.80 m, each within about 0.10 m. Each wall should be 3.00 m high within about 0.10 m. Add an Entrance Door with OverallWidth 0.95 m in South Wall. Add windows named Living Window West, Living Window North, and Kitchenette Window with OverallWidth values of 1.20 m, 1.20 m, and 1.00 m respectively, hosted in separate openings in West Wall, North Wall, and East Wall. Other non-required details may vary.
